patterns_discovered.description: Standard pattern for display-only denormalized fields (tenant_name, seller_name, buyer_name, city_name, district_name) - always paired with fetch_from AND read_only:1
Consistently used to hide system fields and deprecated JSON columns

patterns_discovered.description: Frappe mechanism for admin-only field write protection on critical fields
Subtotal, tax_amount, total_amount, discount_amount, paid_amount, balance_amount consistently marked read_only with computed values
Status fields frequently lack read_only:1 despite workflow control; only protected by Python validation
Platform-specific role nomenclature indicating Turkish market focus

gotchas_discovered.impact: Critical linking fields (order.buyer, rfq.buyer, listing.seller) lack immutability protection - can be changed after creation
Workflow-controlled status fields can be manually edited; only protected by Python-level validation, not schema-level
Same field concepts (status, tenant, commission_rate) have different protection mechanisms across apps
gotchas_discovered.pattern: Some use permlevel, some use read_only, some rely on workflow only

gotchas_discovered.impact: ~120 fetch_from+read_only fields require careful sync logic; any data inconsistency visible in listing
